bead.title: CL-007a Archive legacy benchmark env profile
bead.description: Archive only the stale benchmark env profile approved by CL-004 row CL-004.10: scripts/benchmark/legacy-4tool-baseline.env. Preserve content under a research/archive path unless implementation review proves deletion is more appropriate.
bead.acceptance: The env profile is moved out of scripts/benchmark into docs/research/archive/ or an equivalent archive path; rg shows no active references to the old path outside cleanup/research history; bash -n or equivalent syntax check passes on the archived env file if applicable; close notes or commit cite CL-004.10.
